value.title: Auntie Rae’s Sweets and Tea Parties
value.address: 4704 Holladay Blvd E, Holladay, UT 84117, United States
value.reviewText:
This place felt like a hidden gem. Cute outside and in; the yard was landscaped, and the white dinning room was so cute.

The glassware was pretty  and the daintiness of everything was just what I was hoping for.  The decorations were a little eclectic, but I loved that there were things that would appeal to kids. I came to tea with a friend, and it was perfect! But I could totally see coming back with my daughter for a mommy daughter date.

As for the food, everything tasted great! My friend loved her tea, and I loved my hot chocolate (with and without raspberry flavor).
The tea sandwiches (chicken salad, and vegetable cream cheese and cucumber dill) were good; the scones, raspberry jam and lemon curd were all really delicious, and the fruit and cheeses were yummy.
We were so full by the end that we took our desserts to go, and the desserts were big!

I used a Groupon, and it was a great value! Though it’s worth noting the groupon doesn’t cover gratuity.

There are some areas that are kids friendly (kids books, etc) and there even a changing table in the bathroom. I didn’t need these this time, but loved that they had them. Also, my data didn’t work, but they had a WiFi network I was able to log into.

I loved my experience here and I hope to visit again!

*If you found my review helpful, I would greatly appreciate a thumbs up (like) so google and I know. Thanks, and Bon appétit!

value.title: Dipp'd Desserts
value.address: 356 N 750 W Ste D-7, American Fork, UT 84003, United States
value.reviewText:
We came here for our dessert club and we all loved it! I can’t wait to come back.

The Food:
My husband and I tried a custom dipped cheesecake bar and the cookies and cream specialty flavor ice cream bar. Both were phenomenal!

For the cheesecake, we did a milk chocolate dip with raspberry drizzle and chocolate shavings on top and they add complementary whip cream.

The cheesecake was semi-frozen, which obviously made it perfect for dipping, but also meant it held its shape well while eating, and it tasted phenomenal.

The ice cream was semi-firm and easy to eat. I don’t normally like biting cold things, but it was fine. I loved the crunch of all the toppings too!

The cheesecake is from the Cheesecake Factory, so obviously amazing, and the ice seemed high quality as well.

The atmosphere:
The restaurant was spacious, well lit, lots of tables, it was clean, simply decorated in a fun manner, with fun music playing.

Service:
They were super friendly and helpful. And there was complementary water on the counter, which was nice.

Everything was great, and like I said, we can’t wait to go back!

value.title: Eliane French Bakery
value.address: 139 S State St #7, Lindon, UT 84042, United States
value.reviewText:
I’m going to be honest, I was put off by the heavy curtains on the windows, eclectic decor, and how they reused order trays. But, when you walk into a French bakery and hear the owner speaking French to a patron, you know you’re in the right place!

The food is what matters most, and they nailed it. We tried the almond croissant (which was a crazy cross between a croissant and cake in consistency), the Napoleon (which was an interesting balance of flaky layers and creamy filling, super sweet frosting and barely sweetened filling), and of course, Macarons!

I fell in love with Macarons in France, and have made them myself, but I have struggled to find any good ones in Utah. It’s very hit or miss, but these macarons were so good! They weren’t like the candy colored, mass produced, stuff you normally find in Utah. They were soft inside and the shells were flavored as well as the filling, and they were so good I keep day dreaming about getting more! Also, they were above average in size, and only 2.75 each.

I can see why this place came recommended!

value.title: Fox Rent A Car Denver
value.address: 24558 E 75th Ave, Denver, CO 80249, United States
value.reviewText:
I’d give them less than one star if it was an option. I only wish I saw the reviews before I booked with Fox.  Unless you like waiting in line for over an hour and half, in a dirty building, PLEASE save yourself the pain of renting from Fox!!! The actual employees were nice enough, but the manager wasn’t even around. The car was also in good condition and clean. But, when I tried contacting Fox’s corporate offices the message system just hung up on me because they had a high call volume.  And there was no option to speak to a representative when I called in.
And finally, when I looked them up on the Better Business Bureau they have over 180 complaints that they have not addressed And a rating of 1.

The Takeaway, if you want to save money but waste your time then go with Fox rental,  because you will pay with your time.

***update
We’ve now finished our rental, returned the car, and got our deposit back all without a hitch. So, aside from sinking about 2 1/2 hours into picking up a car rental, on an already short trip, everything else with Fox rental went fine. I’d give them 1-2 stars, but the extreme wait time is still a deal breaker for me.

value.address: 283 N University Ave, Provo, UT 84601, United States
value.reviewText:
I went tonight with some friends, and not only had a great time, but was super impressed by GetOut Games.

The waiting area was really nice, and the escape room was epic.  There’s men and women’s bathroom in the waiting room/ lobby as well.

We did the Egyptian Tomb room and loved it! The atmosphere, guide, props, clues, sound effects, etc. we’re very cool and we’ll done; we really had a blast!

I loved that they gave us unlimited hints, if we wanted/ needed them, which was particularly helpful because our 4th person couldn’t come, and so we did the room with just 3 people (but we made it out with 2 minutes to spare 🎉💪😄).

It’s roughly $20 a person, and you can schedule online. You have to be punctual, and you get 1 hour to escape.

Parking is a little tricky, but the escape room experience is well worth a little walk! I’m excited to come back and bring my family/ friends to check it out.

value.title: MIXTURAS FUSION | Peruvian • Japanese
value.address: 845 N 100 W #103, Orem, UT 84057, United States
value.reviewText:
This restaurant is a fun fusion of Peruvian and Japanese food.

We tried the Fettuccine Huancaina which is Peruvian. The Huancaina sauce wasn’t my favorite, but it did pair well with the steak. Also, we were sad that the noodles were cut so short because it made it hard to eat them.

We also ordered the Teriyaki Chicken and rice. We were surprised when it came with fries, but even more surprised at how delicious they tasted in the teriyaki sauce! The chicken was tender and delicious and the rice was also good.

And finally, we tried their fried Yuca, and the Chicha Morada drink.

The Yuca was similar to French fries, but heartier. It tasted great on its own, but I would have enjoyed having a dipping sauce with it, even teriyaki.

The Chicha Morada was very unique, but also oddly satisfying. It is made from boiled and spiced purple corn, and is a traditional Peruvian drink. It looks like grape juice, but tastes a lot like a mild, slightly fruitier, spiced cider. I forgot to get a picture of it, but It is definitely worth trying!

The restaurant was clean and well laid out, and the cashier was nice.

value.address: 197 NW State St Ste. B, American Fork, UT 84003, United States
value.reviewText:
Tried here tonight and was pleasantly surprised.

The Dream Burger was a little intimidating to me, but after one bite, I was hooked! It had an unexpected depth and balance of flavors and textures that was quite enjoyable. It was messy, but I actually ate it with a knife and fork, so it was no problem. Also, it came with chips and salsa which seemed unusual, but I liked it.

The Loaded Hash was smaller than I expected, but delicious.

The limeade was on the bitter lime side, like when limes sit in water a long time. I think I’ll try it again next time just in case I just didn’t get a good batch, or better yet, I’ll try their raspberry limeade.

The chicken nuggets were also disappointing. Though they were super crispy, they weren’t seasoned (that I could tell), and the first thing I noticed about their flavor was the taste of the oil it was fried in. Overall they reminded me more of fish sticks than chicken strips.

The Strawberry Tall Cake was incredulous though! I just couldn’t get enough of it. The biscuit was one of the best I’ve ever had! It was tall, with slightly crispy edges, a fluffy center, flavorful, and NOT dry!!!!
I honestly want to go back for just that.

The restaurant was comfortable and the servers nice.

If you get the 16 oz jar (which you get to keep), you choose your ice cream flavors (for a shake or as scoops), a dip/ coating to cover the rim, 1 free small topping which is a rim topping, and 1 large topping which is a treat that goes on top. I’m excited to go back and try an actual shake next time, but I loved the brown cow brownie, cookie butter, and nutty herd scoops that I tried tonight.

value.reviewText:
I hate to give any place that’s trying, a one star review, but I just wouldn’t eat here again, and honestly wish I hadn’t eaten there tonight.

The chips and salsa was small for two people to share, plus the chips were tough! And, although they gave us more of the delicious salsa, they didn’t give us more chips.

More then this, we didn’t enjoy either entree we ordered. The chicken enchiladas were drowned in a strong, bitter sauce, and their was no cheese or anything with the chicken filling to make it not dry/ plain inside.

And my chile relleno was so unpleasant I had to stop trying to eat it because it was ruining my association with my favorite Mexican dish! The cheese inside, though a classic Mexican cheese, was not the melty cheese I expected like at other places (instead it stayed in one large lump). The roasted pepper and breading grossed me out flavor wise and the tomato sauce on top was not good on the chile relleno.

The queso tamale was good, we enjoyed the  beans and rice overall, and the corn tortillas tasted fresh and were heated nicely. Also, the customer service was pretty good.

If you found this review helpful, please like it so Google and I know. Thanks!
